title: Browser request heads
summary: Parse the head of an HTTP/1.1 request (request line and headers) from an in-memory message into method, target, version and headers.
notes: Only Rust crates and the Go standard library are measured: no npm or JSR package in this category parses raw HTTP messages. httparse is zero-copy but the harness result cannot borrow from its input, so its adapter copies into owned strings.
